FROM oraclelinux:9-slim AS stock-runtime
RUN microdnf install -y tar gzip curl ca-certificates && microdnf clean all
RUN curl -fL https://download.oracle.com/java/25/latest/jdk-25_linux-x64_bin.tar.gz -o /tmp/jdk.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /opt/java/openjdk && tar -xzf /tmp/jdk.tar.gz -C /opt/java/openjdk --strip-components=1 \
    && sha256sum /tmp/jdk.tar.gz > /oracle-jdk-sha256.txt && rm /tmp/jdk.tar.gz
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:$PATH
FROM stock-runtime AS os-source
RUN rm -rf /opt/java/openjdk
FROM scratch AS common-os
COPY --from=os-source / /
ENV JAVA_HOME=/opt/java/openjdk
ENV PATH=/opt/java/openjdk/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LANGUAGE=en_US:en LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
WORKDIR /app
COPY docker/build-provenance.json build-provenance.json
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/java"]

FROM common-os AS base
COPY --from=stock-runtime /opt/java/openjdk /opt/java/openjdk

FROM base AS guicedee
COPY guicedee/.env .env
COPY guicedee/target/comparison-guicedee-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee/target/lib/ lib/
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM base AS quarkus
COPY quarkus/target/quarkus-app/ ./
CMD ["-jar", "/app/quarkus-run.jar"]

FROM base AS guicedee-scan
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
COPY guicedee-scan/target/comparison-guicedee-scan-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar app.jar
COPY guicedee-scan/target/lib/ lib/
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
CMD ["--module-path", "/app/app.jar:/app/lib", "-m", "bench.guicedee.scan/bench.guicedee.Main"]

FROM stock-runtime AS maven-build-base
RUN microdnf install -y binutils && microdnf clean all
ARG MAVEN_VERSION=4.0.0-rc-7
ADD https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/${MAVEN_VERSION}/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}-bin.zip /tmp/maven.zip
RUN cd /opt && jar xf /tmp/maven.zip && chmod +x /opt/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}/bin/mvn && rm /tmp/maven.zip
ENV PATH=/opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7/bin:$PATH
COPY docker/repository/ /root/.m2/repository/
WORKDIR /src
COPY pom.xml pom.xml
COPY common/ common/
COPY guicedee/pom.xml guicedee/pom.xml
COPY guicedee/src/ guicedee/src/
COPY guicedee-scan/pom.xml guicedee-scan/pom.xml
COPY guicedee-scan/src/ guicedee-scan/src/
COPY quarkus/pom.xml quarkus/pom.xml
COPY quarkus/src/ quarkus/src/
COPY quarkus-native/ quarkus-native/
COPY guicedee-jlink/ guicedee-jlink/
COPY guicedee-scan-jlink/ guicedee-scan-jlink/

FROM maven-build-base AS application-build
RUN mvn -B -ntp -pl guicedee-jlink,guicedee-scan-jlink -am package -DskipTests

FROM common-os AS guicedee-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee/.env .env
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

FROM quay.io/quarkus/ubi9-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image:jdk-25@sha256:c0ff31764f70469795db5513d674e4721fd8e7e761beddbff741ef5d84e79ed3 AS native-build
USER root
COPY --from=maven-build-base /opt/apache-maven-4.0.0-rc-7 /opt/maven
COPY --from=maven-build-base /root/.m2/repository /root/.m2/repository
COPY --from=maven-build-base /src /src
WORKDIR /src
RUN native-image --version > /native-build-info.txt && \
    /opt/maven/bin/mvn -B -ntp -pl quarkus-native -am package -Pnative -DskipTests && \
    sha256sum /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner >> /native-build-info.txt

FROM common-os AS quarkus-native
COPY --from=native-build /src/quarkus-native/target/*-runner /app/application
COPY --from=native-build /native-build-info.txt /app/native-build-info.txt
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/application"]

FROM common-os AS guicedee-scan-jlink
COPY --from=application-build /src/guicedee-scan-jlink/target/maven-jlink/default /opt/java/openjdk
COPY guicedee-scan/.env .env
ENV GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE=scan
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/java/openjdk/bin/benchmark"]

"""Fresh-process capability and latency comparison; failed parity never becomes a performance win."""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import socket
import statistics
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from upstream import Upstream
from variants import select_variants, ordered_variants, guicedee_jar, guicedee_project, runtime_flags

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def request(base, path, body=None, raw=None, headers=None, timeout=15):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(base+path, data=data, headers=headers or {"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status, content = response.status, response.read().decode()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as response:
        with response:
            status, content = response.code, response.read().decode()
    try: parsed = json.loads(content)
    except ValueError: parsed = content
    return status, parsed, (time.perf_counter()-started)*1000


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def stop(process):
    if process.poll() is not None: return
    if os.name == "nt":
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    else:
        import signal
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try: process.wait(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        if os.name != "nt": os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        process.wait(timeout=5)


def start(command, log, env, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP if os.name == "nt" else 0,
                            start_new_session=os.name != "nt")


def percentile(values, quantile):
    return sorted(values)[min(len(values)-1, int((len(values)-1)*quantile))]


def metric_counts(body):
    if not isinstance(body, str): return {}
    values = {}
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('#') or 'benchmark_quotes' not in line: continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+?)\s+([0-9.eE+\-]+)(?:\s+[0-9]+)?', line)
        if match: values[match[1]] = float(match[2])
    return values


def eligible_comparison(rows, runs, variants):
    expected = {(v['id'], run) for v in variants for run in range(1, runs+1)}
    actual = {(r.get('variant'), r.get('run')) for r in rows}
    return len(variants) > 1 and len(rows) == len(expected) and actual == expected and all(r.get('eligible', False) for r in rows)


def discovery_evidence(log, discovery):
    scanning = 'Initializing ClassGraph scanner for dependency discovery' in log
    deployments = {package: f'Deploying Verticle: {package} -' in log
                   for package in ['bench.guicedee.rest', 'bench.guicedee.service']}
    return {'classGraphInitialized':scanning, 'verticleDeployments':deployments,
            'verified':scanning == (discovery == 'scan') and all(deployments.values()),
            'logLines':[line for line in log.splitlines() if any(marker in line for marker in
                         ['Initializing ClassGraph', 'Classpath scan completed', 'Deploying Verticle: bench.guicedee'])]}


def probe(variant, run, out, upstream, flags, args):
    flags = runtime_flags(variant, flags)
    framework = variant['framework']
    application = guicedee_project(variant) if framework == 'guicedee' else variant['id']
    app_port = port()
    env = dict(os.environ, HTTP_PORT=str(app_port), HTTPS_ENABLED="false", HTTP_HOST="127.0.0.1",
               BENCH_UPSTREAM=f"http://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}", FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST="127.0.0.1:18088",
               GCLOUD_PROJECT="demo-devsuite")
    # Remove implicit JVM tuning from the parent so both variants receive exactly the recorded flags.
    for name in ["JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS"]: env.pop(name, None)
    if framework == "guicedee":
        env['GUICEDEE_DISCOVERY_MODE']=variant['discovery']
        cp = (ROOT/application/'target/classpath.txt').read_text().strip() if not args.docker else ''
        module = 'bench.guicedee.scan' if variant['discovery'] == 'scan' else 'bench.guicedee'
        launch = ['--module-path', str(ROOT/application/'target'/guicedee_jar(variant))+os.pathsep+cp, '-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']
    else: launch = [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar', str(ROOT/'quarkus/target/quarkus-app/quarkus-run.jar')]
    name = f'{variant["id"]}-{run}'
    container = None
    if args.docker:
        container = 'devsuite-bench-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        env.update(HTTP_PORT='8080', HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0', QUARKUS_HTTP_HOST='0.0.0.0',
                   BENCH_UPSTREAM=f'http://host.docker.internal:{upstream.server_port}',
                   FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST='host.docker.internal:18088')
        launch = (['-m', module+'/bench.guicedee.Main'] if variant['runtime']=='jlink' else ['--module-path','/app/app.jar:/app/lib','-m',module+'/bench.guicedee.Main']) if framework=='guicedee' else [] if variant['runtime']=='native' else ['-jar','/app/quarkus-run.jar']
    argfile = out/(name+'.args')

    print(name, 'eligible='+str(row['eligible']), 'failed='+str([k for k,v in row['checks'].items() if not v['passed']]), row.get('error',''), flush=True)

from pathlib import Path

import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DISCOVERY_ENTRIES = {'bench/guicedee/BenchmarkDiscovery.class',
                     'META-INF/services/com.guicedee.client.services.IGuiceDiscovery'}


def verify_scanner_artifact(spi, scanner):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(spi) as original, zipfile.ZipFile(scanner) as scan:
        assert 'module-info.class' in original.namelist(), 'SPI module descriptor is missing'
        assert 'module-info.class' in scan.namelist(), 'Scanner module descriptor is missing'
        assert all(name in original.namelist() for name in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES), 'SPI discovery registration is missing'
        assert not DISCOVERY_ENTRIES.intersection(scan.namelist()), 'Scanner artifact contains explicit discovery'
        assert b'BenchmarkDiscovery' not in scan.read('module-info.class'), 'Scanner descriptor registers discovery'
        business = {name for name in original.namelist() if name.endswith('.class')
                    and name != 'module-info.class' and name not in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES}
        assert business == {name for name in scan.namelist() if name.endswith('.class') and name != 'module-info.class'}, 'Application class sets differ'
        for name in business:
            assert original.read(name) == scan.read(name), f'Business bytecode differs: {name}'


if __name__ == '__main__':
    verify_scanner_artifact(ROOT/'guicedee/target/comparison-guicedee-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar',

            with zipfile.ZipFile(spi,'w') as jar:
                for entry in DISCOVERY_ENTRIES: jar.writestr(entry,b'provider')
                jar.writestr('module-info.class',b'spi-descriptor')
                jar.writestr('bench/guicedee/rest/Resource.class',b'business')
            def write_scan(bytecode, provider=False, descriptor=True):
                with zipfile.ZipFile(scan,'w') as jar:
                    if descriptor: jar.writestr('module-info.class',b'scanner-descriptor')
                    jar.writestr('bench/guicedee/rest/Resource.class',bytecode)
                    if provider: jar.writestr('bench/guicedee/BenchmarkDiscovery.class',b'provider')
            write_scan(b'business')
            verify_scanner_artifact(spi,scan)
            write_scan(b'business',provider=True)
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError): verify_scanner_artifact(spi,scan)
            write_scan(b'different')
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError): verify_scanner_artifact(spi,scan)
            write_scan(b'business',descriptor=False)
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError): verify_scanner_artifact(spi,scan)

    def test_fixture_requires_auth_and_records_retry_attempts(self):
        server=Upstream();thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
        base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}'
        try:
            self.assertEqual(401, request(base,'/benchmark')[0])
            self.assertEqual(401, request(base,'/oauth/token',raw=b'grant_type=client_credentials')[0])
            self.assertEqual(200, request(base,'/oauth/token',raw=b'grant_type=client_credentials',headers={'Authorization':'Basic Zml4dHVyZTpmaXh0dXJl'})[0])
            self.assertEqual([503,503,200],[request(base,'/flaky/test')[0] for _ in range(3)])
            self.assertEqual(3,server.counts['/flaky/test'])
            self.assertEqual(400,request(base,'/benchmark/graphql',{'query':'{ inventoryEntries }'})[0])
            self.assertEqual(200,request(base,'/benchmark/graphql',{'query':'{ inventoryEntries }'},headers={'Authorization':'Bearer fixture-token'})[0])
        finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close()

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<project xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.1.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.1.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.1.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
        <artifactId>parent</artifactId>
        <version>2.5.1</version>
    </parent>
    <groupId>com.guicedee.modules.services</groupId>
    <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
    <name>firebase.admin</name>
    <version>2.5.1</version>
    <properties>
        <project.scm.nameUrl>/GuicedEE/Services</project.scm.nameUrl>
    </properties>
    <description>Grouped Firebase Admin and Google SDK JPMS module.</description>
    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>shade</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <relocations combine.self="override">
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>io</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.io</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>org</pattern>
                                    <excludes>
                                        <!-- Native-image hosted APIs are supplied by the compiler, not shaded dependencies. -->
                                        <exclude>org.graalvm.**</exclude>
                                        <!-- Conscrypt's JNI library looks up these original Java class names. -->
                                        <exclude>org.conscrypt.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.w3c.**</exclude>
                                        <exclude>org.xml.**</exclude>
                                    </excludes>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.org</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.fasterxml</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.fasterxml</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.common</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.common</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.thirdparty</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.thirdparty</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.gson</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.gson</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.errorprone</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.errorprone</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.j2objc</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.j2objc</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.google.re2j</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.google.re2j</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>javax.annotation</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.javax.annotation</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.sun</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.sun</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                                <relocation>
                                    <pattern>com.aayushatharva</pattern>
                                    <shadedPattern>com.google.firebase.internal.shaded.com.aayushatharva</shadedPattern>
                                </relocation>
                            </relocations>
                            <artifactSet>
                                <includes>
                                    <include>*:*</include>
                                </includes>
                                <excludes>
                                    <exclude>org.projectlombok:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.junit*:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.apiguardian:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>org.opentest4j:*</exclude>
                                    <exclude>io.projectreactor.tools:*</exclude>
                                </excludes>
                            </artifactSet>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-antrun-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.moditect</groupId>
                <artifactId>moditect-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.guicedee.maven</groupId>
                <artifactId>flatten-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>com.coderplus.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>copy-rename-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
    <url>https://guicedee.com</url>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.firebase</groupId>
            <artifactId>firebase-admin</artifactId>
            <optional>true</optional>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>com.guicedee</groupId>
                <artifactId>standalone-bom</artifactId>
                <version>${guicedee.version}</version>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
            </dependency>
        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>
</project>
